task: Profile Samsung Electronics from the registries: what the entity is, where it is registered, what identifiers name it, and what it discloses about itself.

entities.name: ProShares Ultra Samsung Electronics
entities.note: Unrelated leveraged ETF fund named after Samsung Electronics; not the company itself

findings.statement: Samsung Electronics' GLEIF-registered legal entity is 삼성전자(주) / SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO., LTD, LEI 9884007ER46L6N7EI764, jurisdiction Korea (KR), status ACTIVE, Korean business registration number 124-81-00998, headquartered in Suwon, Gyeonggi-do.
GLEIF records no known corporate parent for this LEI: both direct-parent and ultimate-parent fields carry a NO_KNOWN_PERSON reporting exception.

GLEIF lists one branch of this LEI (SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS COMPANY LIMITED, LEI 335800A16O7QD1TDQO62, registered in Mumbai, India) and a corporate-group child list including Samsung Display, Samsung Malaysia Electronics, Samsung R&D Institute India-Bangalore, Samsung Eletronica da Amazonia, and the Harman International group of entities (22 ultimate children total per GLEIF pagination).

SEC EDGAR carries a filer entry for Samsung Electronics under CIK 0000879316, name 'SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS CO LTD /FI', entityType 'other', stateOfIncorporation Korea (M5), no ticker or exchange, EDGAR-recorded ein 953170778, lei field null.

CIK 0000879316's 251 listed filings (1995-03-06 to 2015-01-20) are almost entirely beneficial-ownership, tender-offer, going-private, and paper supplemental/annual-report filings tied to Samsung's stakes in other US issuers (e.g. Seagate Technology, Rambus, SunEdison Semiconductor); no 10-K/10-Q/20-F is present and the XBRL company-facts endpoint returns an S3 NoSuchKey error, i.e. no structured financial facts are on file.

possible match — needs confirmation: the GLEIF LEI record (9884007ER46L6N7EI764) and the EDGAR CIK record (0000879316) are linked in this report only by legal name and Korean jurisdiction; EDGAR's own lei field for this CIK is null and GLEIF carries no SEC CIK field, so no registry-asserted key connects them.

A plain GLEIF entity.legalName search for 'Samsung Electronics' (English) returns 47 records but misses the Korean parent entirely (its legalName is recorded in Korean script); the same search also returns an unrelated leveraged-ETF fund, 'ProShares Ultra Samsung Electronics' (LEI 529900JUHLXQE4F70208), and two similarly unrelated Hong Kong CSOP leveraged/inverse products — a realized instance of the name-collision risk the registries' catalogs warn about.

data_gaps: Neither GLEIF nor EDGAR carries Samsung Electronics' financial statements (revenue, profit, headcount); this data is outside both registries' coverage.

EDGAR's filing history for CIK 0000879316 contains nothing after 2015-01-20; whether more recent EDGAR activity exists under a different CIK was not exhaustively checked beyond the first page of a 213-hit full-text search.

GLEIF's parent/child relationship data for LEI 9884007ER46L6N7EI764 is incomplete relative to the actual corporate group: most of the 47 'Samsung Electronics'-named national subsidiaries found by legalName search do not appear in the ultimate-children list (22 total).
No registry-asserted identifier (LEI, CIK, EIN) bridges the GLEIF and EDGAR records used in this profile; the join is by name and jurisdiction only, per the top-level CATALOG.md warning.
